title: FlatVPR: Plug-and-play Geo-linear Residual Adapter for Geometric Rectification of Foundation Model Feature Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2606.01734v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper proposes ``FlatVPR,'' a novel geometric rectification paradigm that effectively bridges the trade-off between map lightweightness and localization accuracy in visual place recognition (VPR) by enforcing a feature manifold structure where any descriptor between two adjacent anchors $\mathbf{z}_A$ and $\mathbf{z}_B$ can be accurately reconstructed via linear interpolation $\hat{\mathbf{z}}_{pseudo} = (1-t)\mathbf{z}_A + t\mathbf{z}_B$, where $t \in [0,1]$ denotes the relative position. translated_title: FlatVPR：用于基础模型特征流形几何矫正的即插即用地理线性残差适配器
translated_abstract: 本文提出了"FlatVPR"，一种新颖的几何矫正范式，通过强制施加一种特征流形结构，有效弥合了视觉位置识别（VPR）中地图轻量性与定位精度之间的权衡。在该结构下，任意两个相邻锚点 z_A 和 z_B 之间的任意描述子均可通过线性插值 ẑ_pseudo = (1-t)z_A + t·z_B 准确重建，其中 t ∈ [0,1] 表示相对位置。尽管 DINOv2-ViT-S/14 等最先进的基础模型能够提供鲁棒的语义特征，但其潜在流形存在显著曲率，会将物理空间中的均匀线性运动投影为特征空间中高度非线性的轨迹，从而阻碍了稀疏锚点条件下的可靠重建。为实现上述基于插值的重建，我们引入了一种残差变换（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: FlatVPR提出一种即插即用的地理线性残差适配器，通过矫正基础模型特征流形的几何曲率使其线性化，使相邻锚点间的描述子可通过线性插值准确重建，从而在视觉位置识别中有效平衡地图轻量性与定位精度。
en_tdlr: FlatVPR introduces a plug-and-play geo-linear residual adapter that rectifies the curvature of foundation model feature manifolds to be geometrically linear, enabling accurate linear-interpolation reconstruction of descriptors between adjacent anchors and effectively bridging the trade-off between map lightweightness and localization accuracy in visual place recognition.
